# Newegg

> > Leading online retailer for computer hardware, electronics, gaming products, and office supplies with a focus on PC components, peripherals, and technology accessories.

Newegg offers a comprehensive marketplace for technology enthusiasts and businesses, featuring products from brands like Innovera, HP, Cisco, Tripp Lite, and MSI. The site includes detailed product pages, customer Q&A sections, and brand stores for specialized shopping experiences.

## Key Topics

- PC components and hardware
- Printer supplies and toner cartridges
- HP LaserJet compatible products
- Touchscreen monitors and POS systems
- Gaming laptops and peripherals
- Network equipment and SFP transceivers
- Remanufactured and aftermarket toner
- Capacitive and multi-touch displays
- Rack-mount power distribution units
- Digital game downloads and Steam codes
- VESA mounting solutions
- Open-frame industrial monitors
- High-yield printer cartridges
- Brand stores and event sales
